free_front_door: YES, three doors, one of them already inside the buyer. (1) THE STOCK VENDOR IS THE FRONT DOOR: the refreshed lifestyle layer (Racco, Odorata, Abelha Rainha — 3–11% reuse, generic faces, no recurring cast) is stock-shaped, Avatim's XMP names Shutterstock, and Adobe Stock BR now bundles 750 images/month + unlimited 'Digitar para editar' AI edits + US$10k indemnity for R$950/month — R$1,27/image against her R$50–75/image. (2) THE TOOL VENDOR: Higgsfield product-photoshoot recipe / Soul ID consistent character at US$49/month, run by the in-house designer who already composites (Água de Cheiro: 87 Photoshop composites; Avatim: Capture One studio). (3) DONE-FOR-YOU AT THE SAME PRICE: Estúdio Fábrica R$53/image (her R$4.500 IS Fábrica's rate card for 60 img + 4 reels, R$4.220) and Make Move ≈R$46/photo with synthetic casting. And the clock does not force a new purchase: 5 of 11 brands re-run ≥25–86% of the previous revista's faces (Amakha ≥86%, Mahogany ≥57%, DeMillus ≥44%, Hinode/Jequiti ≥33%) — the unit is STRETCHABLE, so THE CONSUMPTION-CLOCK TEST fails its second limb. Mahogany's library already looks synthetic (UNVERIFIED).
what_remains_sellable: Narrow: (a) an EXCLUSIVE recurring cast across ciclos — stock faces are non-exclusive (but no identical face was found across 16 brands' revistas: 1.428 face crops, matcher proven on within-brand repeats — so the 'your stock model is in your competitor's revista' hook is NOT supported by evidence); (b) the brand's REAL packshot, label-exact, in a model's hand at print resolution (CMYK/300 dpi) — the vendor's own recipe disclaims small-text verification; (c) deadline reliability to the gráfica every ciclo with one accountable supplier; (d) claim-safe imagery (no efficacy simulation, CONAR 2026 guide). (a) is copyable by any in-house designer with Soul ID in an afternoon; (b)–(d) are ordinary studio value. None is scarce enough to price above Fábrica/Make Move, and the buyers who refresh most are buying stock, not studios.

arithmetic.pool: UPPER BOUND (every mid-size revista buys a full 60–90-image layer outside at R$4.500): 44 measured revistas/yr (10 brands) = R$198.000; + listing-derived fashion books (Facinatus 4, Dicorpo ~5, Quatro Estações ~12, Hiroshima ~16) = 81 ⇒ R$364.500; + 8 unmeasured brands at 4/yr = 113 ⇒ R$508.500. REALISTIC (only NET-NEW on-model images, priced at Fábrica's R$53): Racco 28×12, Abelha 59×4, Odorata 70×4, A Sós 56×2, Água de Cheiro 18×4, Mahogany ~10×6, Ciclo 19×1, Amakha 8×3, Mawwal 6×6, Avatim 3×2 ⇒ ≈R$62.600/yr for the 10 measured cosmetics brands, + fashion books UNVERIFIED (CDN blocked; incumbent there is a R$7,81–20/photo physical studio) ⇒ ≈R$110–140k/yr all-in, before any stock/in-house substitution. H6F's R$810k (20 brands × 9 × R$4.500) used DeMillus's cadence for everyone and assumed 100% outside purchase.
arithmetic.pool_div4: R$49.500 (measured core) · R$91.000 · R$127.000 (upper bound) · ≈R$28–35k (realistic) — ALL below the bar of ≈R$150–185k/yr gross (net R$126–156k + ~R$7,8k tools, ÷0,94 Simples). FAILS THE MARKET-MULTIPLE RULE at every price and count tried.
arithmetic.required_share: Bar ÷ R$4.500 = 33–41 revistas/yr = 2,8–3,4 per month ⇒ 29–36% of the most generous pool (R$508,5k), 76–93% of the measured core (R$198k), 107–168% of the realistic pool.
arithmetic.hours_per_revista: 20,8–55,4 h at maturity (60–90 composited stills × 0,23–0,46 h each — H6D's post-learning per-still rate — + 4 reels 4–8 h + brief/QA/proof/revision call 3–6 h). H6F's 15–20 h is below the bottom of this range. Realisation R$81–216/h vs required ≈R$130–166/h (US$25–32).
arithmetic.capacity: 87 h − ~12 h sales/admin = 75 h ⇒ 1,35–3,6 revistas/month vs 2,8–3,4 needed ⇒ 58–190 h/month required. Fits only if every revista runs at the fast end; at the midpoint (~38 h) she can do ~2/month = R$108k/yr gross, below the bar even with a 100% win rate.

strongest_version: Not a per-revista desk but a per-LAUNCH 'rosto da marca' kit sold to the 3–5 stock-dependent mid-size cosmetics VD brands that actually refresh their lifestyle layer every revista (Racco monthly ~28 new images; Abelha Rainha and Odorata quarterly ~60–70): an exclusive recurring synthetic cast holding the brand's real, composited, label-exact packshot for each lançamento, delivered print-ready to the ciclo deadline plus 2–4 vertical clips for the revendedoras' WhatsApp/TikTok kit (Hinode's own job ad shows brands now build a per-ciclo 'kit de digitalização' for consultants). Price against stock + designer, not against a shoot: R$1.500–2.500 per refresh (≈R$40–60/image), invoiced, no retainer, sold by Portuguese calls to the gerente de marketing. It keeps ORIGINATION ONCE only for the refreshers and trades MACHINE-TEST limb 3 (a proof call per ciclo). Honestly, this is VBPH's HERO kit with a venda-direta buyer list attached — a customer SEGMENT for VBPH (≈10 named brands), not a separate business: the pool cannot carry the bar alone.
honest_floor_usd_month: 150–600 (1–2 refreshing brands at R$1.500–3.000 per revista × 12–16 revistas/yr = R$18–48k gross ⇒ R$9–37k net after 6% Simples and ~R$7,8k/yr tools, at R$5,2/US$). H6F's US$500–1.300 assumed 9 revistas/yr per client and R$4.500 each.
